evidence_quotes: Last onder dwangsom gemeente Westland voor lozen van stedelijk afvalwater
rationale: This Dutch administrative law decision (Rechtbank Den Haag) concerns a municipal enforcement order subject to periodic penalty payments (last onder dwangsom) issued by the Municipality of Westland regarding the discharge of urban wastewater (lozen van stedelijk afvalwater), evaluating proportionality, penalty amount, and compliance period. Because the dispute directly governs urban wastewater/sewage discharge regulation and enforcement, both labels are WATER and the primary governance category is sanitation_sewage.
